forge_intro: Paste an access token: Cleared checks it right away and keeps it on this machine.
forge_use_contents: clones, pushes a session's branch, merges after your approval
forge_use_pull_requests: opens, edits, comments on and closes pull requests
forge_use_commit_statuses: reads the checks of a pull request
forge_use_workflows: only if a ticket may change .github/workflows/
forge_use_issues: only for the GitHub Issues mirror
forge_classic: GitHub names these permissions in English. A classic token with the repo scope works too.
forge_ok_one: GitHub is connected. The token reaches 1 repository: {names}.
forge_ok_many: GitHub is connected. The token reaches {count} repositories.
forge_ok_more: GitHub is connected. The token reaches more than {count} repositories.
forge_set_environment: GitHub is connected through Cleared's settings.
forge_error_refused: GitHub refused this token: it may be expired or badly copied.
forge_error_forbidden: A permission is missing, or the organization has not approved the token yet.
forge_error_unreachable: GitHub did not answer. Check the network, then try again.
forge_error_empty: This token reaches no repository yet, so give it access to yours.
forge_error_environment: The token comes from Cleared's settings: change it there.
forge_error_other: The token could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
gitlab_intro: Create a personal access token on your GitLab, then paste it here.
gitlab_scope_use: opens, comments on, closes and merges merge requests, reads their pipelines, and clones and pushes over https
gitlab_role_use: on each project; Maintainer to merge into a protected branch
gitlab_address_hint: https://gitlab.com, or the address of your own GitLab.
gitlab_create: Create the token on this GitLab
gitlab_ok_one: GitLab is connected. The token reaches 1 project: {names}.
gitlab_ok_many: GitLab is connected. The token reaches {count} projects.
gitlab_ok_more: GitLab is connected. The token reaches more than {count} projects.
gitlab_set_environment: GitLab is connected through Cleared's settings.
gitlab_error_invalid: Paste the token alone, on one line.
gitlab_error_address: Give your GitLab's https address, such as https://gitlab.com.
gitlab_error_refused: GitLab refused this token. It may be mistyped, expired or revoked.
gitlab_error_forbidden: GitLab answered 403: the account may be blocked, or an administrator limits its access.
gitlab_error_scope: The token lacks the api scope, which opening and merging a merge request need. Make one with the api scope.
gitlab_error_unreachable: GitLab did not answer. Check the address and this machine's network, then try again.
gitlab_error_empty: The token reaches no project yet, so make its account a member of the projects Cleared works on.
gitlab_error_environment: The token comes from Cleared's settings: change it there.
gitlab_error_other: The token could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
forge_set_detail: Token saved on {date}. It is never shown again.
forge_set_environment_detail: The token comes from the GH_TOKEN variable of Cleared's environment. Change it there.
gitlab_set_detail: Token saved on {date}. It is never shown again.
gitlab_set_environment_detail: The token comes from the file CLEARED_V2_GITLAB_TOKEN_FILE names in Cleared's environment. Change it there.
